overview: A simple, fast RSS viewer that lets users paste a feed URL and read recent items with minimal dependencies.
goals: Load and display RSS feeds quickly with a minimal stack
Provide a clean, lightweight UI for reading recent items
successMetrics: User can paste a URL and see items within 2 seconds on typical feeds
No unnecessary dependencies beyond the server and parser
openQuestions: Should we support viewing multiple feeds at once or only one active feed?

routes.name: Viewer
routes.purpose: Enter a feed URL and read items

routes.name: RSS Proxy
routes.purpose: Fetch and parse RSS for the UI

uiNotes: Single page layout with URL input, load button, and status banner
States: idle, loading, error, empty, results
Item cards show title, source, date, and short summary

importFormat.description: A single RSS feed URL string

rules: All RSS fetching and parsing happens on the server to avoid browser CORS
Limit results to the 20 most recent items
Strip HTML from summaries and truncate to a short snippet

stories.title: Initialize project and basic server
stories.description: As a developer, I want a minimal project scaffold so I can run the app locally.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a new npm project with scripts: dev, start, test
Install dependencies with `npm install express rss-parser`
Add a basic Express server that serves `public/` at `/`
Add a `tests/smoke.test.js` script and wire `npm test` to run it
Example: running `npm test` exits with code 0 when `server.js` and `public/index.html` exist
Negative case: if `public/index.html` is missing, `npm test` exits non-zero with a clear message

stories.title: Create RSS proxy endpoint
stories.description: As a user, I want the app to fetch and parse RSS feeds so I can view items in the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `GET /api/rss?url=...` that validates the url query parameter
Parse the RSS feed and return JSON with feed metadata and items
Example: requesting a valid feed returns JSON with `feed.title` and a non-empty `items` array
Negative case: missing or invalid `url` returns 400 with `{"error":"invalid_url"}`
Negative case: fetch or parse failure returns 502 with `{"error":"fetch_failed"}`

stories.title: Build the minimal viewer UI
stories.description: As a reader, I want a simple page to enter a feed URL and read recent items.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `public/index.html`, `public/styles.css`, and `public/app.js`
UI includes URL input, load button, status banner, and results list
States: loading shows spinner/text, error shows message and clears items
Example: entering a valid feed URL renders a list of items with title, date, and summary
Negative case: entering an invalid URL shows an error state and no items

stories.title: Remember recent feeds
stories.description: As a user, I want quick access to recent feeds so I can revisit them easily.
acceptanceCriteria: Store the last 5 successfully loaded feed URLs in localStorage
Show a recent feeds list that lets users re-load a feed with one click
Example: loading a valid feed adds it to the recent list and persists after refresh
Negative case: failed/invalid URLs are not added to the recent list
